paper.title: AntiFold: Improved antibody structure-based design using inverse folding

result.summary: AntiFold 是一个抗体特异性逆折叠模型，由 ESM-IF1 在已解析和预测的抗体结构上微调而来 [S1.p6]。它在 CDR 序列恢复上优于现有逆折叠工具，设计序列与原始结构高度相似 [abstract]。在零样本预测抗体-抗原结合亲和力时相关性更强，加入抗原信息后性能进一步提升 [abstract]。AntiFold 对破坏抗原结合的突变赋予低概率，可与蛋白语言模型残基概率协同，用于指导抗体优化 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 抗体优化需要选择能维持结构及相关性质（如稳定性和抗原结合模式）的突变，而现有抗体逆折叠工具在 CDR 区域的序列恢复有限，且 ProteinMPNN 类工具存在链重排、CDRH3 112 位插入或引入 gap 等与抗体结构不兼容的问题 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。因此，本文旨在开发一个抗体特异性逆折叠模型，以改进 CDR 序列恢复和零样本亲和力预测 [S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: A guiding consideration in antibody optimization is selecting mutations that maintain the structure and therefore structure-mediated properties, such as stability and antigen binding mode.
However, the sequence recovery of existing tools for the CDR regions has been limited.

Additionally, ProteinMPNN-based tools have features such as the occasional re-ordering of antibody chains or CDRH3 position 112 insertions, or the introduction of gaps into IMGT numbered antibodies, incompatible with antibody structures.
Here, we present AntiFold, an antibody-specific inverse folding model fine-tuned from ESM-IF1, which significantly improves upon CDR sequence recovery and zero-shot affinity prediction.

method.text: AntiFold 通过微调 ESM-IF1 逆折叠架构在抗体结构上训练，学习给定骨架坐标下序列的条件概率分布 [S0.SS1.SSS3.p1]。训练采用 IMGT 加权 shotgun 和 span masking、逐层学习率衰减，并在预测结构上添加高斯噪声 [S0.SS2.SSS1.p5]。训练分两阶段：先在 OAS 预测结构上微调一遍，再在已解析训练集上微调，当验证损失 10 个 epoch 无改善时停止 [S0.SS2.SSS1.p5]。模型输入抗体可变域结构，输出每个残基的突变容忍度（perplexity）和氨基酸概率，可选指定区域采样序列并用温度控制多样性 [S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: We trained AntiFold by fine-tuning the ESM-IF1 inverse folding architecture (Figure S1) on antibody structures.

The inverse folding problem can be formalized as learning the conditional probability distribution, $p(Y|X)$, of the protein sequence, $Y$, consisting of amino acids $(y_{1},\ldots,y_{i},\ldots,y_{n})$, given the structure, $X$, with spatial coordinates of the backbone atoms (N, C α and C) $(x_{1},\ldots,x_{i},\ldots,x_{3n})$ (Equation (1)).
Based on these results, we chose to train the final AntiFold model with IMGT-weighted shotgun and span masking, layer-wise learning rate decay and added Gaussian noise on predicted structures.
First we fine-tuned ESM-IF1 on one pass of the training dataset of predicted structures from OAS.
Next we fine-tuned the model on the solved training dataset, stopping training when there was no further improvement in validation loss for 10 epochs.
For each residue position, the tool outputs the overall tolerance to mutations without altering the backbone structure (perplexity) and individual amino acid probabilities.
Optionally, the user may specify regions to sample new sequences for, and a temperature parameter to control sequence diversity.

experiments.text: 训练、验证和测试使用与 AbMPNN 相同的数据：来自 SAbDab 的 2,074 个已解析复合物，以及来自 OAS 配对数据库、用 ABodyBuilder2 建模的 147,458 个序列结构，按 90% 拼接 CDR 序列一致性划分（80/10/10）[S2.SS1.p1]。序列恢复在实验结构测试集上评估，并与 ESM-IF1、AbMPNN 比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。结构一致性评估选取测试集中 56 个 X 射线分辨率低于 2.5 Å 的抗体结构，用 ProteinMPNN、ESM-IF1、AbMPNN 和 AntiFold 在温度 0.20 下各采样 20 条序列并重新折叠 [S3.SS2.p1]。结合亲和力预测在抗溶菌酶抗体 Fab D44.1（PDB 1MLC）的 2209 个可变域变体深度突变扫描上评估，并加入 ESM-2 作为序列基线 [S3.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: To enable a direct comparison with AbMPNN, we trained, validated and tested our model on the same data: 2,074 solved complexes from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab), and 147,458 structures of sequences from the Observed Antibody Space (OAS) paired database modeled with ABodyBuilder2.
Each dataset was split using a 90% concatenated CDR sequence identity cutoff (80/10/10 train/validation/test).
AntiFold demonstrated a substantial improvement in AAR on the experimental structure test set as compared to the original ESM-IF1 model (60 vs 43% AAR for CDRH3, p $<$ 0.005; Table 1, Figure S2.
We identified 56 antibody structures in the test set that were solved using X-ray crystallography with a resolution below 2.5 Å.
Next, we sampled 20 sequences for each antibody using ProteinMPNN, ESM-IF1, AbMPNN and AntiFold using a residue sampling temperature of 0.20 (for more details, see Supplementary Methods).
We assessed the ability of AntiFold and other inverse folding models to predict antibody-antigen binding affinity by applying them to a deep mutational scan of an anti-lysozyme antibody.
We calculated the log-likelihoods of the 2209 variable domain variants of Fab D44.1 (PDB 1MLC) (Figure S6).
As a sequence-only baseline, we included the sequence-based ESM-2 model (650M parameters).

findings.text: AntiFold 在实验结构测试集上 CDRH3 的 AAR 为 60%，显著优于 ESM-IF1 的 43%（p < 0.005），也优于 AbMPNN 的 56%，并在其余 CDR 区域（75-84% vs 63-76%）和多数 FR 区域（87-94% vs 85-89%）上表现更好 [S3.SS1.p1]。AntiFold 在已解析和预测结构上 AAR 相似（ΔAAR 约 -0.5%），而 AbMPNN 在实验结构上略差（ΔAAR -2.7%）[S3.SS1.p2]。在抗溶菌酶深度突变扫描中，AntiFold 的 Spearman 秩相关为 0.418，优于 ESM-IF1（0.334）、AbMPNN（0.322）、ProteinMPNN（0.301）和 ESM-2（0.264）[S3.SS3.p1]。加入抗原链后，AntiFold 在所有 CDR 区域性能提升，特别是 CDR2（Sr 42.7 到 47.3%，p < 0.005）和 CDR3（Sr 29.8 到 32.0%，p < 0.005），而 ProteinMPNN 和 AbMPNN 在多数 CDR 区域性能下降 [S3.SS3.p2]。在 124 个变体上，AntiFold 对改善结合亲和力变体的中位秩评分为 80%，优于 ProteinMPNN 的 73%、ESM-IF1 的 57% 和 AbMPNN 的 55% [S3.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: AntiFold demonstrated a substantial improvement in AAR on the experimental structure test set as compared to the original ESM-IF1 model (60 vs 43% AAR for CDRH3, p $<$ 0.005; Table 1, Figure S2.
AntiFold also outperformed AbMPNN for CDRH3 (60% vs 56%), all remaining CDR regions (75-84% vs 63-76%), and most FR regions (87-94% vs 85-89%, Figure S3).
AntiFold achieved similar AAR for solved and predicted structures ( $\Delta$ AAR c-0.5%), unlike AbMPNN which performed slightly worse on experimental structures ( $\Delta$ AAR -2.7%, Figure S2 C).

AntiFold significantly outperformed the other models with a Spearman’s rank correlation of 0.418, versus ESM-IF1 (0.334), AbMPNN (0.322), ProteinMPNN (0.301) and ESM-2 (0.264), assessed by Mann-Whitney one-tailed U tests.

With this additional context, AntiFold’s performance improves in the case of all CDR regions, in particular the CDR2 ( $S_{r}$ 42.7 to 47.3%, p $<$ 0.005) and CDR3 ( $S_{r}$ 29.8 to 32.0%, p $<$ 0.005), but not for framework residues.
Contrary to this, ProteinMPNN and AbMPNN lose performance for most CDR regions when including the antigen chain, while performance on framework residues is largely unchanged.

AntiFold achieved significantly improved separation of these groups, scoring the improved variants with a median rank score of 80% (p $<$ 0.005) versus 73 % for ProteinMPNN, 57 % for ESM-IF1 and 55 % for AbMPNN.
